title: Buffs - Magazine Buffs
blurb: Every magazine issue and what it really does, straight from the game files. Find the best one for your build, compare up to three side by side, or open any issue for what it does and when it works.

basics.title: Magazine basics
lines: The Curator perk card (Intelligence) makes it last 1 hour.
Collector's legendary armour adds time for every piece you wear: 1 piece 36 min, 2 pieces 42 min, 3 pieces 48 min, 4 pieces 54 min, 5 pieces 1 hour, 6 pieces 1 hour 6 min.
With Curator and 6 pieces of Collector's it lasts 2 hours 12 min (we haven't confirmed in game that the two stack).
You can only have one magazine active. Reading another one replaces it.
It stacks with food, a chem, a drink and your bobblehead.
